## About
Paula Magdy designs, builds, and scales modern software across web, cloud, and
backend platforms. Skilled in JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, PHP, cloud
infrastructure, and DevOps. Works at Challenge Group. Alumnus of October 6
University. AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner; Huawei HCCDA-Tech Essentials and
HCIA-AI certified.
